uncertainty.description: Values favour the extremes: dramatic jumps.

uncertainty.name: Anti-Correlated
uncertainty.description: Stored values alternate high and low: a zigzag.

uncertainty.name: Integrator Wander

uncertainty.name: Slow Store
uncertainty.description: Everything stretched over bars for evolving ambient control.

uncertainty.name: Free Clocked Chaos
uncertainty.description: All generators unsynced and fast: loose, jittery movement.

wavetable-osc.name: Mirror Fold

wavetable-osc.name: Digital Crush
wavetable-osc.description: Bit-reduced stepped cycles: lo-fi and gritty.
